patches.value: As j ranges over Fin n and k over Fin m, the family consists of all scalar component sections of V,A,Psp(j),Ssp(j),W(j), and e,d, the products V_k A_k, Psp(j)_k W(j)_k, V_k Ssp(j)_k, V_k Psp(j)_k and W(j)_k Psp(j)_k, the dot products dot(V,A), dot(Psp(j),W(j)), dot(V,Ssp(j)), dot(V,Psp(j)) and dot(W(j),Psp(j)), and every finite real linear combination of these scalar sections, all at time r.
